name: camera-switch
description: Each drone cycles wide → zoom → thermal → wide every 10 s. m30t-01 switches inside its RTMP session (like Pilot 2 is expected to), m30t-02 reconnects for each switch. Expected: viewers get 4001 stream-reset (m30t-01) or 4000 drone-offline (m30t-02) and playback resumes with the new resolution.
